_README: PLACEHOLDER DATA. These plays, times, players and scores are invented so the viewer can be tested before it is wired to Priya's explainer. Do not show them on Demo Day. Only the final score (33-30 OT) comes from the group chat.

plays.who: Colts quarterback to a Colts receiver

swiftie.headline: Colts keep the drive alive on 3rd down
swiftie.what_happened: A quick pass got the Colts past the line they needed. Now they get a fresh set of four tries.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Third down is the bridge of the song. Land it and the song keeps going. Miss it and you usually have to punt.

beginner.headline: Colts convert on 3rd down
beginner.what_happened: The Colts needed 6 yards and got them with a short pass.
beginner.why_it_matters: A team gets four tries to move 10 yards. Making it on the third try resets the count, so they keep the ball.

swiftie.headline: Touchdown, Colts
swiftie.what_happened: The Colts ran it in from 3 yards out. That is 6 points, plus 1 for the kick after.
swiftie.why_it_matters: First points of the night. Opening track energy.

beginner.headline: Colts score a touchdown
beginner.what_happened: A Colts runner carried the ball into the end zone, the painted area at the end of the field.
beginner.why_it_matters: A touchdown is worth 6 points. The kick after adds 1, so the Colts lead 7-0.

swiftie.headline: Chiefs go for it on 4th down and get it
swiftie.what_happened: Instead of punting, the Chiefs tried a short run on their last try and made it.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Going for it on 4th down is a risk. Fail and the other team gets the ball right there.

beginner.headline: Chiefs risk it on 4th down
beginner.what_happened: On their fourth and last try, the Chiefs needed 1 yard and got it.
beginner.why_it_matters: Most teams kick the ball away on 4th down. Going for it keeps the drive alive but gives the ball away if it fails.

plays.who: Chiefs quarterback to the Chiefs tight end
plays.pop_note: Sample pop-culture note. Real notes come only from news articles the explainer cites.

swiftie.headline: Touchdown pass to the tight end
swiftie.what_happened: The Chiefs quarterback found his tight end in the end zone. Tie game.
swiftie.why_it_matters: The tight end is the player who blocks and catches. This catch ties it at 7.

beginner.headline: Chiefs tie it with a touchdown pass
beginner.what_happened: A Chiefs pass was caught in the end zone for 6 points, plus 1 for the kick.

plays.who: Chiefs quarterback, picked off by a Colts defender

swiftie.headline: Interception: the Colts steal it
swiftie.what_happened: A Colts defender caught a pass meant for a Chiefs player. The Colts now have the ball.
swiftie.why_it_matters: A turnover is a plot twist. One team was attacking, and now the other team is.

beginner.headline: Colts intercept a Chiefs pass
beginner.what_happened: A Colts defender caught the ball instead of the Chiefs receiver.
beginner.why_it_matters: An interception gives the ball to the other team. It is one of the biggest swings in a game.

swiftie.headline: Colts kick a 51-yard field goal before halftime
swiftie.what_happened: With 3 seconds left in the half, the Colts kicked it through the posts for 3 points.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Colts lead 10-7 going into the break.

beginner.headline: Colts field goal from 51 yards
beginner.what_happened: The kicker sent the ball between the tall yellow posts.
beginner.why_it_matters: A field goal is worth 3 points. Colts lead 10-7 at halftime.

swiftie.headline: Sack on 3rd down
swiftie.what_happened: A Colts defender tackled the Chiefs quarterback before he could throw.
swiftie.why_it_matters: The Chiefs lose yards and will likely have to punt.

beginner.headline: Chiefs quarterback sacked
beginner.what_happened: The quarterback was tackled behind the line before he could pass.
beginner.why_it_matters: A sack loses yards. On 3rd down it usually means the team kicks the ball away.

plays.who: Colts quarterback to a Colts receiver

swiftie.headline: Colts take the lead back with a touchdown
swiftie.what_happened: A 22-yard catch in the corner of the end zone puts the Colts up 23-20.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Third quarter, lead change. This game is not a one-sided album.

beginner.headline: Colts touchdown, Colts lead
beginner.what_happened: A Colts receiver caught the ball in the end zone.
beginner.why_it_matters: The Colts go back in front, 23-20.

swiftie.headline: Chiefs go 35 yards for the lead
swiftie.what_happened: A Chiefs runner broke free and went all the way. Chiefs lead 27-23.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Late in the 4th quarter, every score counts double for the nerves.

beginner.headline: Long Chiefs touchdown run
beginner.what_happened: A Chiefs runner got past the defense and ran 35 yards to score.
beginner.why_it_matters: The Chiefs lead 27-23 with about 5 minutes left.

swiftie.headline: Colts score with 41 seconds left
swiftie.what_happened: The Colts quarterback ran it in himself. Colts lead 30-27.
swiftie.why_it_matters: With so little time left, the Chiefs need points fast or the game is over.

beginner.headline: Colts touchdown late in the game
beginner.what_happened: The Colts quarterback carried the ball into the end zone.
beginner.why_it_matters: Colts lead 30-27 with 41 seconds to go.

swiftie.headline: Chiefs tie it as time runs out
swiftie.what_happened: A 55-yard kick at the buzzer makes it 30-30.
swiftie.why_it_matters: Tied after four quarters means overtime. Bonus track.

beginner.headline: Field goal ties the game, overtime next
beginner.what_happened: The Chiefs kicked a field goal with no time left.
beginner.why_it_matters: A tie after 60 minutes sends the game to overtime, an extra period.

swiftie.headline: Chiefs win it in overtime
swiftie.what_happened: A field goal in overtime ends it. Chiefs 33, Colts 30.
swiftie.why_it_matters: That's the final. The Chiefs take the win.

beginner.headline: Overtime field goal wins it for the Chiefs
beginner.what_happened: The Chiefs kicked a 42-yard field goal in overtime.
